branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A German soft cheese from the Bergader Privatkäserei in Waging am See, with a white camembert-type rind over a blue-marbled interior. Made from pasteurised cow's milk with two noble-mould cultures, one for the rind and one for the blue; ideally ripe at four to six weeks.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
